title: SegaSaturn Internet Vol. 1
native_title: ＳＥＧＡＳＡＴＵＲＮ インターネット Ｖｏｌ．１
overview: SegaSaturn Internet Vol. 1 is internet software for the Sega Saturn, part of the SegaSaturn Networks line. Used with the Sega Saturn Modem, which plugs into the console's cartridge slot, it lets you browse the World Wide Web and send and receive email from your Saturn through your own internet service provider.
